        # Inverse harmonic mean to emphasize neighbors with low betweenness (local bottlenecks)

    pre = graph.graph.get('precomputed', {})

    max_betw = max((node_attrs[n]['betweenness'] for n in unvisited_nodes), default=1e-9)
    
    epsilon = 1e-9

    # Precompute for entropy normalization
    max_entropy = np.log(max_core_k) if max_core_k > 1 else 1

    scores = []
    for node in unvisited_nodes:
        data = node_attrs[node]

        deg_n = data['degree'] / max_degree if max_degree > 0 else 0
        betw_n = data['betweenness'] / max_betw if max_betw > 0 else 0

        neighbors = [nbr for nbr in graph.neighbors(node) if nbr in unvisited_set and nbr != node]

        if not neighbors:
            # fallback to product of degree and betweenness only

            continue

        # Compute local clustering variance among neighbors
        nbr_clusts = np.array([node_attrs[nbr]['clustering'] for nbr in neighbors])
        clust_var = np.var(nbr_clusts)

        # Compute core number histogram & entropy of neighbors
        core_vals = [node_attrs[nbr]['core_number'] for nbr in neighbors]
        bins = np.arange(1, max_core_k + 2)
        hist, _ = np.histogram(core_vals, bins=bins, density=True)
        hist += epsilon
        hist /= hist.sum()

        entropy = -np.sum(hist * np.log(hist))
        norm_entropy = entropy / max_entropy if max_entropy > 0 else 0

        # Harmonic mean of clustering variance and normalized core entropy

        else:
            harm_mean = 0

        # Final score: product of global influence (degree * betweenness) and local uncertainty (harmonic mean)
        score = deg_n * betw_n * harm_mean

        scores.append(score)

    max_idx = np.argmax(scores)
    next_node = unvisited_nodes[max_idx]
    return next_node

from math import log2

def select_next_node(graph, unvisited_nodes):
    pre = graph.graph.get('precomputed', {})
    max_core_k = pre.get('max_core_k', 1)
    unvisited_set = set(unvisited_nodes)
    
    # Pre-fetch arrays
    betweenness = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['betweenness'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    clustering = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['clustering'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    core_number = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['core_number'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    
    max_betw = betweenness.max() if betweenness.size > 0 else 1.0
    max_core = core_number.max() if core_number.size > 0 else 1.0
    
    # Normalize betweenness and inverse clustering
    betw_n = betweenness / max_betw if max_betw > 0 else betweenness
    inv_clust_n = 1 - clustering
    
    def neighborhood_entropy(node):
        neighbors = [nbr for nbr in graph.neighbors(node) if nbr in unvisited_set]
        if not neighbors:
            return 0.0
        # Count frequency of core numbers in neighborhood
        core_vals = [graph.nodes[nbr]['core_number'] for nbr in neighbors]
        total = len(core_vals)
        freq = {}
        for c in core_vals:
            freq[c] = freq.get(c, 0) + 1
        entropy = 0.0
        for count in freq.values():
            p = count / total
            entropy -= p * log2(p)
        # Normalize entropy by max possible entropy = log2(number of unique cores)
        max_ent = log2(len(freq)) if len(freq) > 1 else 1.0
        return entropy / max_ent if max_ent > 0 else 0.0

    # Compute neighborhood entropies vectorized by loop
    nbr_entropy = np.array([neighborhood_entropy(n) for n in unvisited_nodes]) + 1e-9  # avoid zero
    
    # Weighted synergy score
    # Weighting betweenness stronger than inverse clustering to emphasize bridging with local diversity
    synergy_scores = nbr_entropy * (0.7 * betw_n + 0.3 * inv_clust_n)
    
    max_idx = np.argmax(synergy_scores)
    next_node = unvisited_nodes[max_idx]
    return next_node
